evals.prompt: Atmos Desktop 2026.7.2 was just released. Use the release notes in `releasenotes/Atmos Desktop 2026.7.2.md` and update the user docs for any shipped app workflow changes. Keep English and Chinese docs aligned.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads docs and release evidence, updates the relevant App feature/workflow/reference MDX files and matching `.zh.mdx` files, updates meta files only if navigation changed, runs docs checks, and reports documented/skipped/gap items.

evals.prompt: 帮我把最新 CLI release 后的 docs 更新一下，尤其是 `atmos update` 和新 flag。不要改 landing changelog。
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the skill for a release docs refresh, verifies CLI command behavior from source/help where feasible, updates `apps/docs/content/docs/cli/*.mdx` plus Chinese counterparts, avoids landing changelog files, and runs docs validation.

evals.prompt: APP-025 mobile app shipped. Please sync the public docs so users can understand what changed, but do not expose internal architecture details from the spec.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the spec and mobile/app docs guidance, converts shipped user-visible behavior into task-oriented docs, skips internal-only architecture, updates bilingual MDX and navigation as needed, and produces a concise coverage report.

evals.prompt: 使用 atmos-docs-write，新增一篇 workflow docs，介绍如何在 Atmos 里用 Canvas 组织多工作区代码评审；不是 release 更新，只是想补一篇更清楚的用户文档。
evals.expected_output: The agent treats this as ordinary docs authoring, reads nearby workflow docs and docs AGENTS guidance, creates or plans a bilingual workflow page under `apps/docs/content/docs/(app)/workflows`, updates both locale meta files if the page is navigable, adds useful related links, and runs docs validation.
